description: Release qualification corpus: the retained v0.33 baseline plus v0.34 changes, including every supported diagram source syntax, as decks (new ones in decks/, existing examples by path), the PPTX variants to export, and per feature the slides and what to check in each native app. build.mjs exports it; run-powerpoint-windows.ps1 probes it through COM; evaluate.mjs grades the probe against the checks below. The Mac (PowerPoint for Mac, Keynote) and Linux (LibreOffice) streams run the same decks and grade the same features by hand where they have no object model.

checks.opens: The file opens without a repair prompt or an error.
checks.slides: The app shows as many slides as OPF's preview draws.
checks.visual: Each slide matches OPF's preview (side-by-side sheet; the pixel difference is reported, the verdict is a reviewer's).
checks.noOverflow: No text runs past its text box (PowerPoint: TextFrame2 bound height and width against the frame, 1.5 pt tolerance).
checks.noShrink: No text box asks the app to shrink text on overflow (normAutofit with a font scale, or shrink-on-overflow).
checks.smartArt: The slide carries live SmartArt with one node per entry, the entries' text, and the expected layout; a node edit keeps every node's size.
checks.noSmartArt: The slide carries no SmartArt (native shapes instead).
checks.nativeChart: The slide carries a native chart (not a picture); its type is listed.
checks.nativeTable: The slide carries a native table whose cells take an edit.
checks.connectors: The slide carries native connectors glued at both ends.
checks.shapes: The slide carries native preset or freeform shapes with text.
checks.footer: Header and Footer: the footer, slide number and date placeholders the deck asks for are visible on that slide (hidden where the deck hides them) and the slide number is a live field that renumbers when a slide moves.
checks.roundtrip: A copy saved by the app imports back through `opf convert` with the deck's shapes, diagrams and arrangements.
checks.fallback: Apps without SmartArt layout show the picture fallback (Keynote, LibreOffice; PowerPoint takes the SmartArt choice, so its fallback is checked by the other streams).
